first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding most directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation by improving time-to-value. Verify the strongest onboarding evidence and the main activation-focused alternative before committing. Promotional pricing carries known 30-day retention risk and conflicts with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source directly addresses the 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value -2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, aligning better with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing. Activation messaging is a credible fallback, but onboarding simplification can improve both completion and early adoption while retaining positive downstream value evidence.
